dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: How was the meeting with the manager?
dialogue.reading: ˈhaʊ wʌz ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ wɪð ðə ˈmænɪdʒər?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Not great. He constantly interrupts me. I wish he would let me finish my sentences!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːt ˈɡreɪt. hiː ˈkɑːnstəntli ˌɪntəˈrʌpts miː. aɪ ˈwɪʃ hiː wʊd ˈlɛt miː ˈfɪnɪʃ maɪ ˈsɛntənsɪz!

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: He does that to everyone. I wish he would listen more.
dialogue.reading: hiː ˈdʌz ðæt tu ˈɛvriwʌn. aɪ ˈwɪʃ hiː wʊd ˈlɪsən ˈmɔːr.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: And his expectations are unrealistic. He wants a full report every day.
dialogue.reading: ənd hɪz ˌɛkspɛkˈteɪʃənz ər ˌʌnriːəˈlɪstɪk. hiː ˈwɑːnts ə ˈfʊl rɪˈpɔːrt ˈɛvri ˈdeɪ.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: He's a workaholic. He's in the office at seven every morning, and he expects everyone to be the same.
dialogue.reading: hiːz ə ˌwɜːrkəˈhɔːlɪk. hiːz ɪn ði ˈɔːfɪs ət ˈsɛvən ˈɛvri ˈmɔːrnɪŋ, ənd hiː ɪkˈspɛkts ˈɛvriwʌn tə bi ðə ˈseɪm.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I wish he would go home earlier! Then we could go home, too.
dialogue.reading: aɪ ˈwɪʃ hiː wʊd ˈɡoʊ ˈhoʊm ˈɜːrliər! ˈðɛn wiː kʊd ˈɡoʊ ˈhoʊm, ˈtuː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Ha! Did you talk to him about the emails at night?
dialogue.reading: ˈhɑː! dɪd juː ˈtɔːk tə hɪm əˈbaʊt ði ˈiːmeɪlz ət ˈnaɪt?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Yes. He said he would try to stop. But he sent me three emails last night.
dialogue.reading: ˈjɛs. hiː ˈsɛd hiː wʊd ˈtraɪ tə ˈstɑːp. bʌt hiː ˈsɛnt miː ˈθriː ˈiːmeɪlz ˈlæst ˈnaɪt.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: I just wish he would understand that we have lives outside work.
dialogue.reading: aɪ dʒʌst ˈwɪʃ hiː wʊd ˌʌndərˈstænd ðæt wiː ˈhæv ˈlɪvz ˌaʊtˈsaɪd ˈwɜːrk.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: Maybe we should all talk to him together.
dialogue.reading: ˈmeɪbi wiː ʃʊd ˈɔːl ˈtɔːk tə hɪm təˈɡɛðər.
